The '''Chief of Quarters''' was a section chief position aboard [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The Chief of Quarters commanded the Quarters section which was responsible for housekeeping and maintenance aboard the ship. The Chief of Quarters commanded a small staff of [[deckhand]]s and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were charged with keeping the common areas and [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] quarters clean, and running the galleys and [[autochef]]s. The Chief of Quarters was the most junior section command aboard the ship, and was usually headed by a junior [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. The chief reported to the [[Operations officer/Legends|Operations Officer]].<ref name="FOP" />
